U023.prompt: 镜头固定。首帧是从一扇只开着一指宽的黑色门缝向外看出去的画面：门缝两侧是黑暗的门板边缘，缝里是凌晨三点雾中的城市。门不动，门缝始终只有一指宽。缝外的城市在动：高架桥上的车灯缓缓流过，远处高楼的窗灯安静地亮着，雾气慢慢飘过。城市的光是冷白和钢蓝色。画面里没有人。
accept: 5 s 里至少有连续 2.67 s 可用：门缝宽度不变、门没有打开或变宽、车灯在流动
镜头固定
没有人、没有红色、没有任何文字或标识

U045.prompt: 镜头固定。她从一排闭着眼睛、一动不动的副本中间，一步跨过地面上的白色标线，停在线外，冰灰色的眼睛直视镜头，神情平静而带着压迫感。她身边的副本始终闭着眼睛，一动不动，身上的灯都是熄灭的。冷蓝的光雾贴着湿润的地面缓缓流动。
accept: 5 s 里有一段约 2.53 s：开始时她脚尖贴着标线，结束时她已站在线外并停下直视镜头
副本全程闭眼、静止、灯灭、银发同款，不变形、不移动
镜头固定
身份符合 canon v4，耳挂与立领红线在画面右侧
跨线不完整或任何副本动了，就算失败
U045.status: postponed: the user chose 「改用多参考模式」 (redesign with an IRIS identity sheet, new preview, new approval)

order: one at a time: submit → fetch → per-shot gate (shot-gate-reviewer, video-analysis MCP) → next; continuity report (continuity-supervisor) and lint before each submit

placement.digital_human: clip second 0 = song time of the audio window start (unit start − 0.3 s); after fetch, align the clip's own audio to the vocal stem by cross-correlation (motion-kit/tools/sync_check.py) and use only the aligned [unit start, unit end]; the page may round the audio length to mm:ss (floor or ceiling); a clip longer than its audio (5.00 s → 5.13 s last time) is trimmed by the alignment; judge it composited with the original song at normal speed
placement.seedance: generate 5 s, choose the usable window inside it per the unit's acceptance list (U023 2.67 s, U045 2.53 s); the film keeps the T4 master as its only audio

budget.cap_note: 1155 credits is the reserved ceiling for the seven takes, not a quote or a settled price
budget.rule: read the page price, duration and exact balance before and after each submit; any unknown outcome stops the pilot

stop: the digital-human entry review refuses the new face: stop, no preprocessing to get past it
a take repeats a frozen face, broken teeth, extra hands or identity drift: stop that lane and report, no extra take
the page shows an audio length that is neither the floor nor the ceiling of the file length: stop
